_doc: Repo-local Claude Code settings for RytmRandomizer.
Post-push code review is wired through four mechanisms (see
docs/CODE_REVIEW_HOOK_SETUP.md), all sharing scripts/code_review_gate.py:
1. THIS file's PostToolUse hook (below) runs the gate in
`--mode claude-hook` after a `git push`: it no-ops on any other
command, and on a push runs the mechanical gates (lint + strict
touched-production typing + architecture + V1.34 parity) then re-prompts the 8-step code-review
skill via the hook's additionalContext channel.
2. .codex/hooks.json — the codex analogue (`--mode codex-hook`).
3. .githooks/pre-push — the universal mechanical backstop for ANY tool
(`--mode git-hook`) once core.hooksPath is set (`just install`).
4. The CI `architecture` job enforces the same gates server-side.
SCHEMA NOTE: `matcher` MUST be a string, and each entry carries a nested
`hooks` array of `type: command` entries. An earlier version used a
matcher OBJECT plus an `action.Agent` block, which this Claude Code
rejects ("settings file failed to parse / expected string, received
object"). A `command` hook cannot dispatch the code-reviewer agent
directly, so the command re-prompts the review through additionalContext
instead (the same wiring codex uses). You can also run it on demand with
the /code-review skill or the code-reviewer agent (.claude/agents/).
The command prefers the repo virtualenv (.venv) so the gate's lint/test
tools resolve, and falls back to `python3` on PATH otherwise.
See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and .claude/rules/architecture.md for the
architecture spec the review enforces.
